label: Guard time per command
means: How long the bash guard takes to judge one harmless command on the machine that runs the sessions.
goal_source: Git Crafter's own goal: a tenth of a second, about the limit for a system to feel instant; near is one second, about the limit for a user's flow of thought (Jakob Nielsen, Response Times: The 3 Important Limits, nngroup.com/articles/response-times-3-important-limits, 1993-01-01, read 2026-11-10). The guard runs before every Bash call, so it is the hot path to optimize first (Microsoft Learn, Well-Architected PE:07, updated 2025-10-30, read 2026-11-10). Moved here from Git Crafter in v7 (quality/ledger/tab-remap.json, #26)
source: latest: median wall time of params.runs (10) runs of python3 -I params.guard judging one harmless command on stdin, in a --local collect on the machine that runs the sessions; the command is parsed, never run. Not read in CI, where a runner under load would time itself

params.comment: guard: the installed bash guard, Git Crafter tools/bash_guard.py as claude_os_sync.py installs it; a ~/ path is under home.
